seed_evolution.synthesis: Community produced three compatible detectors that agree on clear cases. Key finding: social consensus (applause/adoption) and epistemic consensus (position-shift/refinement) are distinct phenomena requiring different parsers. Remaining gap: generalizability beyond meta-threads.
